title: Unified ECG Manifest Row
description: Machine-readable contract for one row emitted by the ECG dataset normalization adapters. This contract follows docs/normalization-pipeline.md and targets the final combined normalized manifest.

original_source_dataset.description: Clean source dataset key before normalization and the single manifest source key.

patient_id.description: Unified patient identifier generated by Nano ID with size 8.

original_patient_id.description: Patient identifier exactly as provided or derived from the source dataset.

split_group_id.description: Patient-level split key. For v1 this should match patient_id.

patient_record_count.description: Number of ECG records in this dataset for the same generated patient_id.

is_multi_record_patient.description: True when patient_record_count is greater than 1.

source_path.description: Loader base path or single-file path, relative to repo root or dataset root.

source_header_path.description: Header path when separate from signal data, such as .hea; null when not applicable.

source_signal_path.description: Signal path when separate from header data, such as .dat, .mat, or .h5; null when not applicable.

signal_key.description: HDF5 dataset key such as /ecg, otherwise null.

num_leads.description: Number of ECG channels. Current normalization target is clinical 12-lead ECG.

duration_sec.description: Native duration in seconds, equal to num_samples / sampling_rate_hz.

age_at_recording.description: Patient age at the time of this ECG record when available.

recorded_at.description: Recording date or timestamp when available.

raw_labels.description: Original label payload, serialized as JSON.

source_label_atoms.description: Parsed atomic source labels, serialized as a JSON list.

source_label_descriptions.description: Source taxonomy descriptions for parsed atoms, serialized as JSON.

normalized_labels.description: Shared training labels, serialized as a JSON list.

split_balance_group.description: Derived split QA bucket used for stratification and split reports, not as a model input.

label_provenance.description: How labels were produced or validated.

label_mapping_statuses.description: Per-atom mapping statuses, serialized as a JSON list.

label_review_flags.description: Per-record union of label mapping review flags, serialized as a JSON list.

include_for_training.description: True only when the record is clean enough for training and validation.

exclusion_reason.description: Pipe-delimited exclusion reasons when include_for_training is false.

quality_flags.description: Dataset-native quality fields and normalization quality flags, serialized as JSON.

normalized_labels.description: Approved first-MVP normalized label vocabulary. Manifest rows store these as JSON strings in normalized_labels.

hard_exclusion_reasons.description: Approved hard exclusion reason atoms. Manifest rows store one or more values pipe-delimited in exclusion_reason.
